name: [🤫] Infinite Nights With Freddy (DOOM)
desc:
IS A FAN GAME! The OST and FNAF are made by Scott Cawthon! Credits to him.

WARNING: THIS GAME IS IN BETA, EXPECT BUGS!

INWF is a rogue-like FNaF : DOOM game. Each night, a new piece of chaos is added into your little nightmares. Buy items during the day to protect yourself against the wild animatronics.

REMINDER : This game was mainly tested on controller and PC. Mobile controls could be a little off.

🔨 Gear up. 
🏃Flee from the animatronic, or fight back!
🏆 Survive the longest.
